title: Combined Habitat Safety Score
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apex:reading
| search safety_score=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(safety_score) as avg_safety_score min(safety_score) as min_safety_score by _time tank_name
| sort - _time
value: A combined safety score gives you one fast daily read without losing the option to drill back into the individual sensors later.
implementation: Send combined habitat safety score events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of combined habitat safety score, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It frames what is happening with combined habitat safety score, so odd changes stand out quickly.
